label.move: Move between assets (↑ ↓ go a row in the grid)
label.back: Leave a text field, close full screen, then the side panel, then clear the selection, then the search by meaning, then go back to a window if Mimikit fills the screen
label.skip: From the top of the window: skip to the assets
label.fullscreen: Fill the screen with Mimikit, or go back to a window
label.peek: Quick view in the side panel
label.full-back: Back to the side panel from full screen (Space too)
label.zoom: Zoom an image in full screen (scroll too, drag to pan)
label.zoom-fit: Fit the image back in full screen (double-click too)
label.seek: Back or forward 5 seconds in a sound
label.stars: Change the rating while the stars have focus
label.tag: Add the typed tag (Backspace in an empty tag field removes the last)
label.toggle: Add to or remove from the selection
label.toggle-key: Add the current asset to the selection, or take it out
label.meaning: Find assets that show the typed words (search by meaning)
label.ask: Ask Claude to turn your words into a search
